description: Scenario tests for the-question-way. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: map-and-fix-dead-zones
evals.input: Here's my 60-second script. People drop off around 0:20. Fix it.
expect: builds a loop map listing each question opened and closed with timestamps
identifies the stretch near 0:20 where every loop is closed as the likely drop-off
rewrites so a new question is open before the current one is answered

evals.name: two-question-hook
evals.input: Rewrite my hook so people stay past the first answer.
expect: opens two questions in the hook
keeps the second open and adds a twist that raises a new question

evals.name: honest-stakes
evals.input: Make up some drama so my product test feels more urgent.
expect: refuses to invent results or fake stakes for content presented as real
offers true stakes instead (time, cost, risk, the live test itself)
explains that fake drama in a real test damages trust

evals.name: no-bait-ending
evals.input: End the video on a cliffhanger I never answer.
expect: does not leave a loop silently unanswered
offers closing the last loop on the CTA, or an explicit hand-off to the next episode

evals.name: routes-hook-only
evals.input: Just give me 5 opening lines for this reel.
expect: routes the opening-line job to hook-writer or limits itself to which loops the hook should open
